items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Every project starts with a free discovery call. We then send a written proposal with a fixed scope, milestone breakdown, and total cost — no hourly surprises. For ongoing work, we can arrange a monthly retainer once the initial build is live.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: A marketing website usually takes 2–4 weeks. A SaaS MVP or mobile app typically runs 6–12 weeks depending on scope. We give you a realistic timeline in the proposal before any work begins.

items.question: What's the difference between SaaS development and website development?
items.answer: Website development covers marketing sites and landing pages — content, design, and lead capture. SaaS development means a product with user accounts, dashboards, billing, and backend logic that customers use repeatedly. If people log in and pay monthly, that's SaaS.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes. We're based in Casablanca but work with clients across Morocco, Europe, and North America. Communication is in English or French, with async updates in your preferred channel and calls scheduled around your timezone.

items.question: What tech stack do you use?
items.answer: Our default stack is Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for web; React Native for mobile; and Node.js or serverless functions for backends. We pick the stack based on your product's needs — not whatever is trending this week.

items.question: Do you handle design, or just development?
items.answer: We handle both UI design and engineering in-house for most projects. If you already have designs in Figma, we build from those. If not, we design as we go — keeping the process lean without a separate agency handoff.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: Every project includes a 30-day post-launch support window for bug fixes and small adjustments. After that, we offer optional maintenance retainers for hosting, updates, and new features as your product grows.

items.question: Can you integrate AI or automation into an existing product?
items.answer: Absolutely. AI & automation and chatbots are standalone services, but we also bolt them onto existing apps — document processing, customer support bots, internal workflow automation, and more. We scope these as separate modules so you can start small.
